name: se-skills
description: Chip vendor SE (System Engineer / Application Architect) workflow skills — 16 skills, 3 MCP servers, SessionStart hook. Full lifecycle: requirements decomposition → architecture design (system/SW/HW) → specification authoring → cross-department review (6 types) → traceability validation.

interface.shortDescription: 16 systems engineering workflows with draw.io, Visio, and math MCP servers.
interface.longDescription: SE Skills provides 16 structured engineering workflows covering the full systems engineering lifecycle for chip design. Covers requirements decomposition, system/SW/HW architecture design, specification authoring, cross-department design reviews, and traceability validation. Includes 3 bundled MCP servers: draw.io for architecture diagrams, Microsoft Visio for formal documentation, and an engineering math engine for MCU datasheet calculations. Built for chip vendor SEs and application architects working on complex embedded systems.
defaultPrompt: Decompose these product requirements into traceable system requirements.
Review this architecture design across HW/SW/Test/System perspectives.
Generate a traceability matrix from requirements to test cases.
